subject: Usage ladder + grace-window onboarding for Hosted API commit increase
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Coleman <aisha@fluxcart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Usage ladder + grace-window onboarding for Hosted API commit increase

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short proposal for an incremental commit increase and an onboarding approach we call the "usage ladder" (staged commit steps + a short grace window for safe burst). High level:

- Current: 2M tokens/month hosted commit, monthly rate band A.
- Proposal: Step-up to 4M tokens/month over three months (2M -> 3M -> 4M).
- Pricing: blended rate for committed tokens; overages inside the 15% grace window billed at a discounted burst rate.
- Operational safety: 2-week soft-throttle window while we enable KV cache warm-ups and optimized batching.

What this gives FluxCart: predictable unit cost while preserving short-term spiky traffic for Black Friday tests. I attached a one-page addendum with the staged schedule, rate table, and the DocuSign link for signature.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the start month (we suggested Sep 1).
2) Procurement issues PO referencing the addendum.
3) We kick-off onboarding with an ops checklist (we'll loop in Karthik for provisioning).

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk the table.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: fluxcart_commit-addendum_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear plan. We're interested in the staged approach. A few questions before procurement raises a PO:

1) Can you confirm the burst rate inside the 15% grace window (we want to compare to our current overage charges)?
2) If we hit sustained 20% overages during the first month, is there an automatic throttle or do you flag us first?
3) Is the DocuSign route required, or can we accept by email/PO reference?

We'd like the start date to be Sep 1, but I need confirmation on the billing treatment and a quick runbook for our SREs. Samir, looping you for procurement.

Best,
Aisha Coleman

On Mon, 23 Aug 2027 at 10:42, Aisha Coleman <aisha@fluxcart.com> wrote:
> Sergio —
>
> Thanks for the clear plan. We're interested in the staged approach. A few questions before procurement raises a PO:
>
> 1) Can you confirm the burst rate inside the 15% grace window (we want to compare to our current overage charges)?
> 2) If we hit sustained 20% overages during the first month, is there an automatic throttle or do you flag us first?
> 3) Is the DocuSign route required, or can we accept by email/PO reference?

Thanks for the quick questions — answers below.

1) Burst rate: within the 15% grace window, overage consumption is billed at 50% of the standard pay-as-you-go rate for hosted API tokens (we show the table in the addendum). That means a significant discount compared to base overage.
2) Sustained 20%: Our default is to notify and engage an ops cadence before hard throttles. For the first two months of the ladder we set a proactive alert threshold at 110% and an operational intervention at 120% sustained over 12 hours. Automatic hard throttles are a last resort — we prefer to work with your SREs (Karthik will coordinate).
3) PO vs DocuSign: Legal prefers an executed addendum (DocuSign) for commit changes, but we can accept a PO that references the addendum + signature on our side to set the billing start. Procurement, to be safe we usually ask for the DocuSign route; can expedite if you send PO + email confirmation.

I also attached a short runbook for SRE onboarding and a suggested provisioning timeline. Karthik — can you confirm ops availability the week of Aug 30 for a 60-minute handoff?

Cheers,
Sergio
[Attachment: fluxcart_ops-runbook_v1.txt (text/plain)]

- Configure telemetry: route-level tracing and token-level cost breakdown enabled for the first 90 days.
- Add a safety rule: soft-throttle at 120% sustained over 12h; alert to oncall + SRE.

I'll open an internal Ops ticket and include SRE contact field so FluxCart can send sample traces. Marissa — can you draft the provisioning ticket with the PO/deal reference? I will add the infra SLAs and capacity reservation ETA.
